E-grok-build-00249E1https://docs.x.ai/build/features/dashboard.md2026-10-04not recordedee7fe471601153b1c7a40880531b95fa4d5260a4a2d0bd3f65eb982abdf3b7e9Agent Dashboard, raw lines 5-5yesThe dashboard is a fullscreen overview of every session: which agents need input, which are working, and which are done.
